scope: Eight new prompt formulations on four source behaviors; evaluator only, not agent input. No claim that subsystem concepts were unseen in all earlier investigations.

corpus.selection: Freeze the current local product source before inference; exclude tests, documents, reports and evaluator rubrics.

unchanged: 7/8 complete, >=3 per language, no baseline task/clause regressions or unsupported claims; writer4/4 per language; +1 complete task OR >=20% fewer bytes on shared complete tasks. All original timing, tool, round and 64 KiB limits retained.
controls: Compare both variants against the same newly pinned freeze. Historical Server receipts are not controls for this cohort. No question editing after observation.

topics.english: How does opening a reader behave when the existing index lock is absent?
topics.russian: Что происходит при открытии читателя, если файл существующей блокировки индекса отсутствует?
clauses: other system errors propagate; no publication is created

topics.english: What separates generated integrity verification from source freshness when opening a session?
topics.russian: Чем проверка целостности сгенерированного снимка отличается от проверки актуальности исходников при открытии сессии?
clauses: verified modes load and validate the generator identity
verified snapshot alone records source freshness as not-assessed
required currentness checks the source and manifest identity before use

topics.english: Which recovery actions are proposed for stale context, and can proposals execute automatically?
topics.russian: Какие действия предлагаются при устаревшем контексте и могут ли они выполниться автоматически?
clauses: stale index proposes inspect-impact and explicit rebuild
receipt failures and declared blockers generate review actions
policy and session-proposed actions use automatic_execution false

topics.english: Which conditions make a saved task continuation ready, and how is review tracked separately?
topics.russian: При каких условиях продолжение сохранённой задачи готово и как отдельно отмечается необходимость проверки?
clauses: current index and current checkpoint age are required
complete pack, no declared blockers and unchanged task wording are required
drift, assertions and receipt review independently contribute to review_required
